title: HER: Human-like Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning for LLM Role-playing

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the rate of 'Mixed Selection' during Generative Reward Model (GRM) training to detect if the model collapses into uniform 'all-A' or 'all-B' dimension-wise judgments rather than properly evaluating trade-offs.
Evaluating and mitigating reward model shortcut behaviors by constructing balanced candidate-order mixtures and tracking performance on 'flipped' sample pairs.
Addressing reward hacking vulnerabilities by including length-contrastive pairs in the training data to prevent the reward model from exploiting verbosity shortcuts.
